company.name: BillionToOne
company.shortDescription: BillionToOne is a precision diagnostics company that focuses on genetic testing for disease detection.
company.description:
BillionToOne is a precision diagnostics company that quantifies biology to create molecular diagnostics accurate, efficient, and accessible for all. The company's patent-pending molecular counter platform is a technology platform that can accurately count the DNA molecules to the single-count level. BillionToOne's mission is to make pre-natal testing safe and affordable for every expecting mother. Its novel technology can detect even single-gene disorders such as thalassemia through a simple blood test. They are replacing amniocentesis, an invasive and risky procedure that has a high miscarriage risk, with a safe and affordable blood test, starting in developing countries.

BillionToOne was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.

aiResearchSummary.text: BillionToOne is developing a liquid biopsy assay for genomic profiling of circulating tumor DNA that detects single nucleotide variants, indels, copy number variants, fusions and microsatellite changes. They create target-associated molecules and dilution tagging for quantification of biological targets and fragment analysis for quantitative diagnostics. They also build quality control templates for sequencing-based assays, molecule counting of methylated cell-free DNA, and non-invasive prenatal testing. Their work spans oncology, prenatal genomics, and quantitative molecular diagnostics.
